headline: Samsung has new Galaxy headphones in the works
summary: Samsung's Galaxy Wearable app code hints at new over-ear headphones. Reportedly named "Galaxy H1," they could challenge AirPods Max. Expected launch in 2027, marking Samsung's first over-ear model.

headline: A RAMageddon guide to back-to-school laptop shopping
summary: Laptop prices are elevated due to an ongoing RAM and storage crunch. This "RAMageddon" makes some models significantly more expensive. Students seeking affordable laptops face a challenging market.

headline: Lamborghini’s flagship Revuelto levels up with SV trim
summary: Lamborghini introduces a new, enhanced SV trim for its Revuelto flagship. The automaker aims for drivers to become "one with their vehicle." This strategy prioritizes immersion over minimizing distractions.

headline: The X-Files creator Chris Carter wanted to make a more horrific movie
summary: Chris Carter originally envisioned a grislier X-Files movie. 20th Century Fox executives rejected his more horrific script. Carter wanted to explore faith and the supernatural with agents Mulder and Scully.

headline: First Trailer for Star Wars: Starfighter Shown at D23 — Here's What We Saw
summary: Lucasfilm debuted the first trailer for Star Wars: Starfighter. The trailer premiered at the Disney fan event, D23. Details of what was shown were revealed following the event.

headline: X-Men Cast Confirmed to Include Inde Navarette as Rogue, Adam Driver as Mister Sinister, Maya Boyd as Storm, and More | D23 2026
summary: Marvel Studios confirmed a new MCU X-Men movie reboot cast. Inde Navarrette will play Rogue, Adam Driver as Mister Sinister. Maya Boyd is confirmed as Storm, among other revealed names at D23 2026.

headline: New Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Shows Doctor Doom Raising an Army of Sentinels
summary: Marvel Studios released a new Avengers: Doomsday trailer. The trailer reveals Doctor Doom's formidable power. It also shows his large army of Sentinels.

headline: Marvel Studios Reveal Debut VisionQuest Trailer, James Spader's Ultron Shown in Human Form
summary: Marvel Studios unveiled the debut trailer for "VisionQuest." The trailer features James Spader's Ultron in human form. Further details about the series were revealed.

headline: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row, found dead
summary: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday was found dead in London. His family expressed shock and grief over the loss. Arday was previously embroiled in a plagiarism controversy.

headline: Fires prompt national alert as 19 homes destroyed
summary: A national alert has been issued due to widespread fires. Nineteen homes have been destroyed across England and Wales. The prime minister reported 37 active fires in the region.

headline: Temporary ban on disposable BBQs as military deployed to help battle wildfires
summary: A temporary ban on disposable BBQs has been implemented. The government warns of "significant risk" in drought conditions. Military personnel are deployed to assist in battling wildfires.

headline: Five years after the Taliban swept to power, does the West have any influence?
summary: Five years have passed since the Taliban regained power. Questions arise about the extent of Western influence in Afghanistan. Many are debating if the West retains any bargaining chips.
